target: Kharif (autumn + winter) rice yield, tonnes per hectare (milled-rice basis, as published by DES)

protocol.evaluation: rolling-origin: the forecast for season t is trained only on seasons before t
protocol.selection: For each lead time and season, the pool member with the lowest mean squared error over the previous 8 seasons is used.
protocol.intervals: split conformal on the previous 10 seasons' relative errors of the deployed system, same lead time

leads.Jul: issued after the end of month 7
leads.Aug: issued after the end of month 8
leads.Sep: issued after the end of month 9
leads.Oct: issued after the end of month 10
leads.Nov: issued after the end of month 11

protocol.disclosure: The first protocol picked a single model on a fixed validation period (2006-2014). On the test period (2015-2024) that choice lost to the plain trend. The deployed system therefore uses online selection: for each lead time and season it uses whichever pool member had the lowest error over the previous eight seasons - something a forecaster could have done in real time. Because this change was made after seeing the first test results, the test-period numbers of the online system are not fully independent; both protocols are reported side by side.

chosen.description: For each lead time and season, the pool member with the lowest mean squared error over the previous 8 seasons is used.
